question: There are _____ sub-schemes under the PM-YASASVI Scheme.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 

__ 
 
• The **PM-YASASVI Scheme** stands for the **Pradhan Mantri Yashasvi Scholarship Scheme**, launched by the Government of India to provide financial assistance to economically weaker students belonging to specific categories. 
 
• Under the **PM-YASASVI Scheme**, there are **two sub-schemes** specifically designed to address the needs of students from backward communities, ensuring that they receive adequate support for their education. 
 
• The two sub-schemes are: 
 
 
• **Top Class School Scholarship Scheme**: This scheme focuses on providing scholarships to students studying in reputed schools. 
 
• **Top Class College Scholarship Scheme**: This sub-scheme supports students pursuing higher education in top-tier institutions. 
 
 
 
• The scheme primarily targets the **Other Backward Classes (OBC), Economically Backward Classes (EBC), and Denotified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Tribes (DNTs).** 
 
• The scholarships aim to promote **social equity** and ensure that financial constraints do not hinder the academic aspirations of meritorious students. 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 

__ 
 
• **Eligibility Criteria:** 
 
 
• The scheme is open to students belonging to **OBC, EBC, and DNT categories**. 
 
• The annual family income of the applicants must not exceed **Rs. 2.5 lakh**. 
 
• Students must have secured admission in **recognized schools or colleges** under the specified sub-schemes. 
 
 
 
• **Key Features:** 
 
 
• Scholarships cover **tuition fees, living expenses, and other educational costs**. 
 
• It encourages students to pursue higher education without the burden of financial constraints. 
 
• The scheme promotes **inclusive development** by supporting marginalized communities. 
 
 
 
• **Implementation:** 
 
 
• The scheme is implemented through the **National Testing Agency (NTA)**, which conducts a qualifying examination for applicants. 
 
• Scholarship funds are directly transferred to the beneficiaries' accounts via the **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)** mechanism. 
 
 
 
• **Important Sub-schemes:** 
 
 
• **Top Class School Scholarship Scheme:** Provides financial assistance to students in classes 9 and 10 for their education and related expenses. 
 
• **Top Class College Scholarship Scheme:** Supports students pursuing undergraduate, postgraduate, or professional courses in reputed institutions. 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 

 
 
• **Focus on Social Equity:** The scheme ensures that students from economically weaker sections of society have equal opportunities for education. 
 
• **Merit-Based Selection:** The scholarships are awarded based on the performance of students in the qualifying examinations conducted by the NTA. 
 
• **Government Commitment:** The PM-YASASVI Scheme reflects the Indian government’s commitment to promoting education for all, especially for underprivileged sections. 
 
• **Digital Infrastructure:** The scheme leverages technology for application, selection, and fund disbursal processes, ensuring transparency and efficiency.
